name: Sekai no Kanata
source:
What would you do if you could go to another world apart from now?
I want to go if I am.
It doesn't end with a dream story.
But the reality is cruel
That's why I have a dream ...

[From [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/26865]Freem![/url]]
translation:
如果你可以去另一个世界，你会做什么？
如果可以的话我也想去。
它并没有以梦想故事结束。
但现实是残酷的
这就是为什么我有一个梦想……

[来自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/26865]Freem！[/url]]
